description: This file defines a factory class 'JdbcTemplateFactory' that provides methods to create instances of 'JdbcTemplate' and 'NamedParameterJdbcTemplate' using a 'RoutingDataSource', tailored for a specific tenant in the Fineract platform.

classes.name: JdbcTemplateFactory
classes.description: A factory class that creates JdbcTemplate and NamedParameterJdbcTemplate instances configured with a RoutingDataSource for a specific tenant.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a JdbcTemplate instance for the given tenant.

methods.name: createNamedParameterJdbcTemplate
methods.description: Creates a NamedParameterJdbcTemplate instance for the given tenant.
